meta.name: doctor
meta.description: Run a read-only hygiene + documentation audit on the current repo. TRIGGER when the user says "is this repo healthy", "check hygiene", "audit this repo" (when they mean inspect, not remediate), "what's drifted", "run doctor", "run a health check", "audit docs", "check for doc drift", "what's broken in this project", "are the hooks still installed", "/nyann:doctor". Do NOT trigger on "fix this repo" / "remediate" / "bring it into compliance" — those are retrofit (audit + fix). doctor reports, never writes. Do NOT trigger on "what does this repo do" (that's a docs pointer, not a hygiene audit).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
